teamId.label: NFL Team Filter
teamId.helpText: Pick the team this subreddit follows. Game threads will only post for that team's games. Choose 'All Teams' for sport-wide subs that cover every game.

autoPostgame.label: Auto-post postgame threads
autoPostgame.helpText: When enabled, the bot will automatically post a Postgame Thread the moment a game ends. Recommended for active subreddits. Disable for single-thread discussion style.

postgameWinTitle.label: Postgame Win Title (optional)
postgameWinTitle.helpText: Custom title for postgame threads when your configured team WINS. Leave blank for default format. Placeholders: {team} = your team's name, {opp} = opponent's name, {teamScore} and {oppScore} = scores. Example: 'Victory Monday! {team} {teamScore}, {opp} {oppScore}'. Only used when a specific team is configured in the Team Filter.

postgameLossTitle.label: Postgame Loss Title (optional)
postgameLossTitle.helpText: Custom title for postgame threads when your configured team LOSES (also used for ties). Leave blank for default format. Same placeholders as the win title. Only used when a specific team is configured in the Team Filter.

threadType.label: Thread type
threadType.helpText: "Game Thread" is the standard mode — posts a Game Thread for each game, plus an automatic Postgame Thread if enabled above. "Broadcast Thread" runs the app as an advanced/analytics companion to your existing game threads: posts use the Broadcast label below instead of "Game Thread", and NO automatic postgame or postponement threads are posted (the app only posts the threads you create from the menu).

options.label: Game Thread (standard — posts game + postgame threads)

broadcastLabel.label: Broadcast label (optional)
broadcastLabel.helpText: Only used in Broadcast Thread mode — the wording used in place of "Game Thread" in the post title. Examples: "Broadcast Thread", "Advanced View", "Live Scoreboard". Leave blank to use "Broadcast Thread".

broadcastDelay.label: Broadcast delay
broadcastDelay.helpText: Delay the live scoreboard by a few seconds so fans following along on a TV or streaming feed aren't spoiled by seeing plays before they happen on their screen. Off shows real-time data. Pick the delay that best matches how far behind your feed runs. No plays are skipped — the game just runs this far behind.

items.label: Post today's NFL game threads
items.description: Create a Game Thread for every game scheduled today (filtered by team if configured).

items.label: Post postgame threads for completed games
items.description: Manually create Postgame Threads (or postponement notices) for any completed/postponed games that don't yet have one. Use as backup if the cron missed one.

items.label: Allow re-posting removed game threads
items.description: Use this if a Game Thread was deleted or removed and you need the bot to post it again.
